Tests slot history sysvar binary size, footprint, and alignment bounds.

# Purpose
This file defines a small unit test for the `fd_sysvar_slot_history` binary format. It imports the test data file `test_sysvar_slot_history.bin`, then checks that the binary size matches `FD_SYSVAR_SLOT_HISTORY_BINCODE_SZ`, that `fd_slot_history_decode_footprint()` returns `FD_BINCODE_SUCCESS`, and that the decoded object size matches `FD_SYSVAR_SLOT_HISTORY_FOOTPRINT`. It also verifies that `fd_slot_history_align()` returns `FD_SYSVAR_SLOT_HISTORY_ALIGN`. The `test_sysvar_slot_history()` function runs the bounds test and leaves a placeholder for more checks.
